The only designated evacuation point is Tarkeshwar shelter. Dhunche school is not one, so nobody can be dropped there.

- **Benighat pensioners:** a 12-minute round trip saves two elderly people, who would cost 100 to defer, so it is worth doing.
- **Thakre couple and Dhunche pupils:** one combined trip from Tarkeshwar through Thakre to Dhunche and back takes 132 minutes. That is cheaper than collecting only the Thakre couple (72 minutes) and deferring the pupils (120), which would total 192 for the two stops against 132 combined.
- **Capacity:** the car is full (4) on the way back from Dhunche, which works because the Benighat pair is dropped first.

Total: 12 + 132 = 144 minutes, with nobody deferred.
